name: Tonarizuma ~Hirusagari no Haitoku Sakushu~
original_name: 隣妻 ～昼下がりの背徳搾取～
source:
“My husband is such a loser. We haven’t had sex in about three years.”
“That long? Things must be tough for you, Aki.”

Aki Tsutsumino and Sanae Kinohara.
They’re my next-door neighbors in the apartment building where I live.
There I was, sitting across from the two of them as they got more and more animated, feeling completely out of place.
Why on earth was I being forced to listen to these married women talk so candidly and openly about their sex lives…!?
I couldn’t exactly listen with keen interest… and thanks to that, even though I was in my own room, I felt incredibly uncomfortable.

“Hey, have you… been having sex lately?”
“You’re still young. You want to do lots of naughty things, right?”

Wait… Aki? Why are you slowly closing the distance between us?
Ignoring what I said, Aki-san kept getting closer… Wait, she’s so close!?
Just as I instinctively tried to pull away, Aki-san grabbed my arm as if to stop me from escaping.
…Ah, she smells nice…
While I was distracted by that… Aki-san pressed her lips close to my ear.

“Hey… do you want to… do it with us right now…?”

Huh…? W-what on earth…?
Before I even had time to react, I felt a soft, warm weight on my back—Sanae had climbed on top of me.

“Is that… okay…? Do you… not like us…?”

translation:
“我老公真是个没用的废物，我们已经差不多三年没做过了。”
“这么久？那你也太难熬了吧，亚希。”

堤野亚希与衣原早苗——
她们是住在我隔壁的公寓女邻居。
看着坐在对面的两位人妻越聊越起劲，夹在中间的我简直如坐针毡。
我到底为什么要被迫坐在这里，听两位已婚太太如此露骨直白地大聊闺房秘事啊……！？
我总不能摆出一副津津有味的表情附和……结果明明是在我自己的房间里，我却浑身不自在到了极点。

“呐，你最近……有在做吗？”
“毕竟你正是血气方刚的年纪嘛，肯定很想做各种色色的事吧？”

等、等等……亚希姐？你怎么一点点往我这边靠过来了？
亚希姐完全无视我的慌乱，越凑越近……等等，这也贴得太近了吧！？
就在我下意识想要往后退开的瞬间，亚希姐一把拽住我的胳膊，封死了我的退路。
……啊，好香的味道……
趁我被体香迷得走神的一刹那……亚希姐将温润的红唇贴到了我的耳畔。

“呐……要不要现在就……和我们俩做呀……？”

咦……？这、这到底是怎么回事……？
还没等我反应过来，后背便传来一阵柔软温热的重量——早苗姐已经从背后整个人贴到了我身上。

“不可以……吗……？难道你……讨厌我们吗……？”
